environment.description: AWS Lambda function running Python 3.9 runtime, deployed via SAM template with default execution role (AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole + S3 read/write). Lambda has /tmp with 512MB ephemeral storage. Function runs in default Lambda execution environment with standard Amazon Linux 2 filesystem. Environment variables include AWS credentials (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN) available at runtime. Network: VPC-attached with NAT gateway for outbound internet access.
